adminNotice.title: Welcome to TheDesiTadka v1.3.0!
adminNotice.message:
Experience our biggest visual & performance upgrade yet:

• Modern Glassmorphism & 3D UI: Translucent frosted glass bottom dock, 3D card elevation, and smooth spring animations.
• Vibrant Color Palettes: Choose between Sunset Amber, Cyber Neon, Oceanic Aurora, Emerald Matrix, and Crimson Royale in Settings.
• Instant Multi-Threaded Search: Real-time progressive search streaming displays results concurrently without waiting minutes.
• 74 Verified Providers: Enhanced feed grab, embed resolution, and streaming performance across all 74 sources.
